original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.tools.export_endurance_panel import export_panel

out = {
  "shallow_panel": export_panel(agent='Logos IV', mode='shallow',
                                dir_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons',
                                out_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/dashboard/endurance_shallow_logos_iv.json'),
  "deep_panel": export_panel(agent='Logos IV', mode='deep',
                             dir_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons',
                             out_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/dashboard/endurance_deep_logos_iv.json')
}
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
